name: Professional Office White Porcelain Suite
marketing_tip: Stay centered and productive with this professional-grade tea set designed for the modern workspace.
body: Designed for the busy professional, this set includes a refined gaiwan and cups that fit perfectly on an office desk. The high-quality white porcelain is durable and easy to clean, ensuring a seamless transition from work to tea.
